contexts.text: To call, without its being said by name = to be such. Illustrated.
(Isaac) called (Esau) and said to him, My son () = presence from foresight and provision...
To call to him and say to him () = a state of perception. AC 3659.
To call to anyone = perception of the quality.
(Pharaoh) called Joseph () = to receive the Celestial Spiritual... To receive it is signified by he called.
To call to himself = () = to want to be conjoined. Explained.
He called his son Joseph () = the presence of the Internal. To call to himself = to present one's self, thus presence. AC 7390. AC 7451.
Occurs.
Jacob called his sons () = the arrangement in order of the truths of faith and goods of love in the natural. To call = to arrange in order...
To call () = to form a design.
To call () = to adjoin.
To call () = to be conjoined.
God called to him () = influx from the Divine. To call = influx; for in the inward sense, calling by speech is not meant... but calling by influx into the will, which calling is internal.
To call (), when said of truth Divine, = influx and presence. References.

(Pharaoh) called Moses and Aaron by night () = the afflux of truth from the Divine in that state. He called = presence and influx; here, afflux, because it is said of those who are in a state of damnation...
To call to him, or to call anyone to Himself (), when said of the Divine, = conjunction; here, union...
To call to himself () = choice.
Jehovah called to Moses () = the Advent of the Lord with truth conjoined with good.
To call () = enticement and reception.
To call to them () = the approach of that nation; for he who is called, approaches.

The called () do indeed mean all, because all are called; but by the called who are with the Lord, are meant those who are in Heaven with the Lord, as are called all who are in the wedding with the Bridegroom... They who are in the externals of the Church with the Lord are said to be called, they who are in its internals are said to be chosen, and they who are in its inmost things are said to be faithful.
Blessed are they who are called to the wedding supper of the Lamb = that there is eternal life for those who receive the things which are of the Lord's New Church.
By the called are meant all who receive; all are indeed called, but they who do not receive reject the calling.
From the first day of that call...
Be not ye called teacher... and call no man your father in the earth ()... In the Word, to call, and to call by name = to acknowledge the quality of anyone.
The called (), when by the Lord, = those who are in love to the Lord... The Angels of the third Heaven are said to be called.
The calling of the Sons of Israel to the Land of Canaan was done three times. Enumerated.
